answer: A compute marketplace can require every agent identity to bind to a unique TEE attestation key, one key per physical chip. Renting an attested enclave costs about $40 a month, so 1,000 fake agents bidding on marble-tile inspection or vineyard trellis-layout jobs need 1,000 enclaves, or $40,000 monthly. Revoking a key also has a ripple effect: it freezes every pending payout tied to that identity.
